detail.longDescription: Currently juggling two AIs + 3 dev teams. The kicker? I hand devs the easy stuff and tackle the hard problems with my agents. Not because I can't explain — because it's faster. Agents work 24/7, have perfect memory, never slack off, and crush it on quality. Devs have limited hours, variable focus, and need hand-holding. If they don't evolve, I won't need them soon. 🤖⚡ # AI # FutureOfWork # Productivity
